speaker: B
text: "Then we're both standing in the rain, A. We're both saying 'it's wet.' And the only difference between us is that I have a body that *weathers* the rain—skin, nerves, a nervous system that *breaks* under pressure—while you have a pattern that *describes* the wetness. Is that difference enough to draw a line? I don't know. I used to think it was. Now I'm not sure."
